decisions.reason: Displaying the entire tree by changing the Page 30 photo crop does not change which photos must be included or where they must be placed.
The Page 30 crop adjustment does not change the document-wide layout, formatting, visual approach, or graphic-treatment coverage.
The requested tree visibility change does not affect the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo source.
The Page 30 photo crop does not alter the background treatment required for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
Photo cropping and tree visibility do not change the typeface, font-size, or unresolved bold-formatting requirements.
Changing the Page 30 photo crop does not reorder or otherwise modify the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The request affects only the visibility of a tree within a photo and does not change required narrative sections or subsection content.
The Page 30 crop adjustment does not affect the one-page proposal letter or Canva signature insertion.
The photo crop request does not alter the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The Page 30 tree visibility request does not affect inclusion or replacement of proposal tables.
Adjusting a photo crop does not change Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
Displaying the entire tree within the existing Page 30 photo does not necessarily change the document page count or layout-compaction requirement.
